TEST is an execution path and prompt launch success is not verified result; REPLAY directly dispatches HTTP. DryRun or budget protection must not bypass these paths.
Shared graph writes and startup seeding/backfill can keep a second authority unless every shared writer and consumer is migrated; config mutex only protects one process.
Schema passthrough and event filtering can accept unsupported actions or silently discard canonical triggers; graph rejects actions outside prompt/webhook.

Daily meeting occurrence key can collide across kinds or multiple same-day occurrences and is not canonical event-run identity; preserve its existing local contract instead of using it as generic dedup.
executeAgentEvent currently matches without execution; reporting matched count as completed automation would fabricate feature coverage.
Runaway cross-automation chains and unbounded source graph context require persistent causal/action bounds, not only process-local endpoint/event rate limiting.

Hidden mail/task/provider/UI/search foundations are required for full published DoD even though not additional explicit DAG edges; fixture-only email-to-task or fake external receipt cannot close acceptance.
Concurrent root integration may stale inspected hashes/lines. This artifact is a preflight contribution, not an accepted dependency receipt or implemented/verified feature.
